new_test_model_inference_calls_scope: This completed-training record and the precollection gate at snapshot_at_utc. Collection had not started at that gate. Later project inference may already be running when this package is published and is outside this frozen snapshot.
site_text: Formal-pilot-02 completed one epoch over 500 synthetic training updates from 100 conversation families: 500 microsteps and 32 optimizer updates, including a final group of four. No row was truncated, and the base model remained frozen. On one training-row probe, the saved and reloaded adapter produced identical logits; switching the adapter off changed logits by a maximum of 5.34375. These checks validate this training artifact, not intention-tracking quality or general reload equivalence. This record is anchored to the precollection gate. Held-out evaluation is a separate next stage, and quality remains pending.

training.loss_interpretation: Losses are retained as training diagnostics; they are not held-out semantic quality scores or evidence of reduced omissions.

probe.input: The complete encoded training row at index 0; only the final-position logits are compared.
probe.scope: This probe checks saved-adapter consistency and an observed adapter effect on one training input. It does not establish general equivalence, semantic correctness, omission reduction, or end-to-end agent quality.

independent_review.scope: Independent static review of training completion, provenance, coverage, source, and saved adapter headers. No quality inference or blind assignment data was inspected.

version_history.original_run: formal-pilot-01 was controlled-stopped after 13 completed updates; followup-01 remains frozen.
version_history.memory_revision: The cache-management and phase-log revision and two-step smoke remain separately documented in memory-revision-01.
version_history.completed_run: formal-pilot-02 started from the pinned base and a fresh adapter under the v2 lock, not from a partial or smoke adapter.
version_history.causal_claim_limit: Completion demonstrates that this revised run finished; it is not a controlled comparison establishing the cause of the old slowdown or a general speedup/stability benefit.

limitations: The 500 training updates come from 100 synthetic conversation families, not 500 independent real-user scenarios or human gold labels.
All diagnostics here concern a single completed run; they do not measure intention tracking quality, generalization, or assistance quality.
Three forward passes on one training-row probe are engineering verification, not held-out test evaluation. Zero new test calls is scoped to the precollection gate.
The old interrupted run and this fresh revised run do not form a controlled speed or memory-causality comparison.
Quality remains pending in this frozen record even if later collection or scoring has begun; later evidence must be published separately.
Packaging performed static consistency and hash checks only; no additional training, generation, or evaluation was run.
